assertions.name: direction_sanity_gate_verified
assertions.source: §4(d) direction-sanity gate from prop:q-beta-direction-sanity-gate: verifies (1) target magnitude Q_β / [Q_A · cos(α_eff)] ≈ 0.99933 at substrate q_0 (ladder contributes ~0.18%); (2) gate ACCEPTS synthetic candidate F(q_0) = 1.001 within the 10× direction-sanity threshold; (3) gate REJECTS PR #1850-style 1/z(q_0)^5 wild-scaling candidate (>>10× off from target). Step 6 of the 7-step Δ_λ pre-flight checklist; completes the four §4 formalize-first invariants.

description: Verifies the §4(d) direction-sanity gate from prop:q-beta-direction-sanity-gate. Computes the target magnitude at q_0 (Q_β^CODATA / [Q_A · cos(α_eff)] ≈ 0.99933), demonstrates ACCEPT on a synthetic-passing candidate (|F(q_0)| = 1.001) and REJECT on a PR #1850-style failing candidate (z < 1 multiplier against target > 1).

data.target_close_to_unity: 0.99933 — the residual is 0.0675% of Q_A*cos(alpha_eff). NOT 0.998/0.18%: those are the NO-COS quantities Q_beta/Q_A = 0.998325 and its 0.16748% gap.
